description: The Landing Page custom visual is the definitive solution for navigating complex Power BI tenants. Instead of jumping between workspaces, this visual provides a streamlined "Command Center" where users can access every report, dataset, dashboard, and app from one unified interface. It is designed specifically for organizations that need a professional, branded entry point for their end-users. Important Disclaimer: This visual does not directly call the Power BI REST API; it functions as a data-driven interface that visualizes the workspace and item metadata provided within your own connected dataset (e.g., XLSX or Database). Key Benefits: Unified Tenant Overview: Display all your Power BI assets—Workspaces, Reports, Dashboards, and Apps—in one structured view, eliminating the need for constant browser navigation. Custom Logical Grouping: Break free from workspace silos. Create your own custom groups to bundle related reports and datasets together, regardless of where they are stored in the service. Integrated Custom Links: Extend your portal beyond Power BI by adding custom URLs. Link directly to documentation, external websites, or internal tools alongside your data assets.
